description: Central distribution via cahayakualiti899/pricechecker; location-prefixed slides per outlet
changes: Distribution moved to github.com/cahayakualiti899/pricechecker (flat root layout)
Slides are location-prefixed: HQ_Slide1.jpg, TUARAN3_Slide1.jpg, ... - each kiosk asks its API /info for its outlet and loads only its own slides
Slide fallback chain: outlet slides -> chain-wide slide1.jpg -> local images/slider (offline)
Kiosk location cached in localStorage so outlet slides survive a brief API outage
Auto-update URLs point at the new repo; strictly-newer version rule unchanged
